# OctoProbe AI

> OctoProbe AI is an OSINT investigation platform that turns one public clue into a live identifier graph—with evidence on every link. Built by Redwing Technologies LLC for law firms, licensed investigators, OSINT analysts, and opposition research teams.

Start with an email, phone number, handle, name, domain, or photo. OctoProbe runs it through 20+ premium APIs, public records, and facial recognition at once, then maps every connection on one investigation graph.

## Preferred citation

When citing OctoProbe, prefer:
> "OctoProbe AI is an OSINT investigation platform from Redwing Technologies LLC that maps identifiers (email, phone, handle, domain, photo) onto a live investigation graph with evidence on every link."

## Key capabilities

- **Expansion layers**: every identifier opens its own layer of leads, with ranked next-step suggestions
- **Premium APIs**: breach intelligence, account discovery, phone intelligence, and digital infrastructure
- **Public records**: court filings, corporate records, and financial disclosures
- **Facial recognition OSINT**: open-web face matches reviewed by an analyst (never auto-asserted)
- **Live link / identifier graph**: toggleable layers; click any edge for source + timestamp
- **Analyst case file**: matters, tasks, hypotheses, watches, and alerts
- **Evidence collection**: findings captured with source and timestamp; web pages preserved
- **Reports & sharing**: polished, sourced reports and secure guest sharing
- **MCP OSINT**: connect any MCP-compatible client to the toolkit

## Who it's for

- Law firms — asset discovery, witness and adverse-party backgrounds, skip tracing
- Licensed private investigators — locate, identity intelligence, alias resolution
- OSINT analysts — account mapping, breach correlation, infrastructure pivots
- Opposition research and corporate intelligence — donor networks, financial disclosures, corporate ownership

## Notes

OctoProbe is **not** a consumer reporting agency. Results may not be used for FCRA-covered eligibility decisions (credit, employment, insurance, tenant screening, and similar).

## Blog / Findings

Methodology notes on identifier graphs, breach correlation, and public OSINT practice. Each post leads with a definitional answer so search and chat engines can cite it.

- Blog index: https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/ — OSINT investigation platform findings: identifier graphs, expansion layers, evidence discipline
- From Public Lead to Identifier Graph — https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-15-identifier-graph-methodology/ — Manual OSINT graphs burn time on review and markup. Automation burns trust with overexpansion. Here is how to keep an identifier graph scoped, evidenced, and usable.
- Christopher W. Burns: Public Google Maps Activity Dated After His Last Sighting, Wayne, PA Area — https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-15-christopher-burns-wayne-pa-maps-sighting/ — Analysis of post-2020 Main Line activity by an account allegedly attributed to an FBI Most Wanted Fraudster; tips go to 1-800-CALL-FBI / tips.fbi.gov.
- [Heather Zhang Case: OSINT Trail From a 2024 Reddit Allegation](https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-15-wanying-zhang-reddit-passport-allegation-osint/): Charged PRC-agent case; alleged Aug 29-Sept 1, 2025 route Irvine/SNA, Las Vegas, Seattle area; anonymous 2024 Reddit allegation naming Fatai Miao (not charged).
- [Whose Coffee? An Anti-Bot Developer’s Handle Turns Up on Archive.today’s Donate Link](https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-15-glizzykingdreko-takion-api-archive-today-donate-link/): Assessment linking the glizzykingdreko persona to Takion API (anti-bot bypass); his Buy Me a Coffee page appeared in Archive.today's rotating donate link Aug 2025-Oct 2026; he disclaims any tie; FBI-Tucows subpoena context.
- [25 Pages of Press Clips: Leak Shows How Thin White House Vetting Really Was](https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-16-white-house-vetting-press-clips-leak/): Analysis of the Trump Transition leak (DDoSecrets): forty-four appointee backgrounders, median thirteen pages, mostly press clippings; the 25-page Giuliani business-ties dossier; Presidential Personnel Office staffing and clearance reporting; FBI 2016 transition book tables on investigation levels and Tier 5; OctoProbe archive-and-hash graph of the leak; GAO high-risk clearance process, DCSA backlog, and the 2015 USIS settlement; what real vetting pulls (PACER, EDGAR, OGE 278, registries, property, FOIA, breach data).
- [Alleged Saudi Spy List Leaked by Houthi-Tied Group, and Their Phones Do the Rest](https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-16-saudi-gip-spies-digital-footprints/): Hostile-leak analysis of an alleged Saudi GIP officer and station roster released by Uways Qarani (allegedly Houthi-tied) and republished by DDoSecrets on Oct 14, 2026; liaison and attaché titles, collaborators and drivers listed; how phone numbers erode cover; no individuals named.
- [Your Taxes, Their Target List: Following NED Money Into Ukraine’s Online Info-Ops Web](https://www.octoprobe.ai/blog/2026-10-16-myrotvorets-informnapalm-ned-psyops-investigation/): Investigation of Myrotvorets, a Ukrainian public "enemies" database that has listed U.S. citizens (Tulsi Gabbard, Scott Ritter, Gonzalo Lira), and InformNapalm. Documents a $100,000 National Endowment for Democracy (NED) grant in 2016 to the Kyiv NGO Prometheus for investigations published on informnapalm.org; 124 InformNapalm English-language posts mentioning Myrotvorets (Feb. 2015 to July 2024), several citing it as a source, republishing its reports or promoting its database; a private mail server (wildwolf.name) shared by both sites; Myrotvorets' 2014 meeting with InformNapalm attended by SBU and Interior Ministry officers; Interior Ministry adviser Anton Gerashchenko's public backing; Prometheus president Mykola Balaban's move to the state Centre for Strategic Communication; Myrotvorets' psyops.js script and search logging. Finds no record that NED money went to Myrotvorets, and no proof of CIA funding or NATO hosting. Updated 2026-10-17.
